title: SS27 Toddler Girls' Little Meadow
summary: Gentle florals and embroidery for toddler girls: muslin dresses, bloomers and soft knits.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Fatamadrina's "Wildflowers Bloom" uses airy fabrics and delicate handcrafted embroidery <sup>[1]</sup>; Cadhan uses soft organic cotton for sleepwear <sup>[2]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to toddler girls, roughly 1 to 4 years.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Muslin dresses with bloomers.
- Rompers.
- Cardigans.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: - Embroidery with soft backing, covered buttons.

design_implications:
- Easy dressing: snaps at the crotch, wide neck openings.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
